verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's Copilot proactively compares ongoing incidents to past incidents and surfaces suggestions in Command Center/Slack, and AI-generated summaries are created automatically at incident declaration without a human prompt, aligning with the 'digs in before asked' framing. However there is no evidence of correlating deployment/change data or telemetry streams as part of this proactive analysis. Missing for 10: explicit correlation of code/infra changes, explicit telemetry (metrics/logs) ingestion and correlation by the AI investigator, and independent validation of the Copilot's proactive-suggestion quality.
